title: Microtrial tally: latency slices & cost quicksheet
content:
Purpose: compact personal tracking sheet for quick microtrials — capture latency slices, token counts, and immediate hypotheses. I use this to decide which variants to promote to the dev bench.

Quick legend: m=model tag, bs=batch size, q=quantization, kv=prefix cache enabled? (Y/N), tks=total tokens in request, tks_out=generated tokens, cost_1k=estimated cost per 1k output tokens (USD) using current pricing sim.

Runs (most recent first):
| run | date       | m        | bs | q   | kv | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | avg(ms) | tks | tks_out | cost_1k | notes |
|-----|------------|----------|----|-----|----|---------|---------|---------|-----|---------|--------|-------|
| R-091 | 2026-02-27 | rw-vicuna-13b | 1  | int8| Y  | 82      | 210     | 120     | 420 | 128     | 0.045  | kv helpful on repeated prefix; prefill hit ~68% |
| R-090 | 2026-02-26 | rw-vicuna-13b | 4  | int8| N  | 210     | 520     | 310     | 1500| 512     | 0.038  | batching ups throughput but p95 spikes; investigate context switching |
| R-089 | 2026-02-20 | rw-13b-qlora  | 1  | fp16| N  | 95      | 240     | 130     | 460 | 96      | 0.052  | baseline for quality A/B; slightly slower than int8 |
| R-071 | 2026-01-18 | rw-7b-tuned   | 8  | int8| Y  | 350     | 890     | 470     | 3300| 1024    | 0.029  | good throughput; latency tail bad when burst concurrent

Simple derived metrics (single-line formulas I keep in head):
- per-token latency ~= avg(ms) / tks_out  (ms/token, rough)
- effective throughput (tokens/sec) ~= (tks_out / (avg(ms)/1000))
- estimated per-request cost ~= (tks_out / 1000) * cost_1k

Example calcs: R-091 per-token latency ~= 120/128 = 0.94 ms/token; throughput ~= 128 / 0.12s = ~1067 tks/s
Estimated cost per request ~= (128/1000)*0.045 = $0.00576

Immediate hypotheses / action items:
- H1: KV-cache reduces work for repeated prompts but increases p95 when eviction thrashes; reproduce with synthetic prefix variations (script: perf/kv-evict-test).
- H2: Batch size 4 on this instance causes kernel contention raising p95; try 'burst_padding=small' + continuous batching thresholds.
- H3: int8 is fine for perf; re-run quality checks for edge-case hallucinations (open set).

Short experiment plan (next 7 days):
1) 2x microtrials varying bs: [1,2,4] with kv Y/N, record p50/p95 and mem/GPU util (R-092..R-094).
2) A/B of int8 vs fp16 on 100 curated prompts (quality score + toxic filters).
3) Run kv-evict-test with prefix diversity 10k to estimate cache hit decay curve.

Notes to self / scratch:
- Use the lightweight runner: curl to local dev endpoint + header X-Run-ID for tracing. Example:
  curl -s -X POST https://dev.local/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' -H 'X-Run-ID: R-095' -d '{"model":"rw-vicuna-13b","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":128}'
- Save raw traces to /tmp/runs/<run-id>.json then compress and attach to Linear ticket.
- Keep this sheet minimal; push summaries to shared drive if promoting changes to infra or console.

Random quick wins logged: 2026-01-22 reduced p95 by 18% by bumping kernel prefetch to 2 (note: hardware dependent).

End.
